question.en: Draw the activity diagram for setting the working status of artificial satellites. The status is set only for the satellites that are orbiting around Mars. If the satellite shows any error messages, the status is 'idle'. If the satellite doesn't show any error messages, the status will be 'idle' only if the satellite has been working for more than 5 years continuously. Otherwise, the status will be 'in function'.

question.en: Draw an activity diagram for the system described by the following text: The system of the electronic devices vendor offers an option to compare multiple products of the same type. When a user is seeing the details of a certain product, they can choose the compare option. After this, they need to add which other products they want to compare with. The comparison can be done with up to 5 other products. When the user adds all the products they want to compare, the user selects “Compare” and a summary report is shown. From here the user can choose some of the products and get details about it, or they can start a new comparison with other products.

question.en: Draw an activity diagram for the functionality of submitting a paper to a conference. The researcher selects a conference from the list of available conferences and enters the title of the paper to be submitted. Next, the researcher enters the authors one by one, providing their first name, last name, and email address. The system then checks whether the entered author satisfies the conditions for participation in the selected conference (each author may participate in at most three papers at the same conference). If the conditions are not met, an error message is sent to the researcher. Otherwise, the researcher proceeds with the next author, if any. After all required information has been entered, the researcher clicks the “SUBMIT” button, upon which a confirmation message is sent via email to all authors.
